IN PHOTOS: Members of the Ateneo community marched towards Ateneo Gate 2.5 from the Zen Garden for a candle-lighting ceremony and prayer vigil in commemoration of the 40th anniversary of the People Power Revolution. Attendees also participated in a noise barrage to protest against ongoing corruption issues and to reaffirm the Ateneo community’s commitment to truth and justice.

The event was organized by the Ateneo Martial Law Museum and Library, together with the Sanggunian, Council of Organizations of the Ateneo - Manila, The Ateneo Assembly, and the Ateneo Student Catholic Action.

Photos by Jio Japson and Joseph Castillo
